subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should embedded agent turns adopt this PR's retry ownership model—zero SDK retries when unconfigured, configured retries still allowed in-window, plus one bounded full fallback-cycle retry for connection and transport-timeout failures—and its resendable terminal takeover behavior?
rationale: The code is internally consistent and proof-positive, but the remaining choice changes established retry budgets, fallback timing, session terminal state, and message-delivery behavior for existing users; source inspection cannot determine the intended compatibility policy.

options.title: Approve the coordinated semantics
options.body: Accept the patch's owned steering, scoped SDK retry default, bounded outer retry, and takeover resend behavior as the canonical agent-runtime policy.

options.title: Narrow retry behavior first
options.body: Keep the session-fence and resend fixes but revise the retry budget or configured-retry interaction before merge.

options.title: Pause for a different recovery design
options.body: Do not merge until maintainers choose a queue or replay recovery model that avoids asking the user to resend.

recommendation.title: Approve the coordinated semantics
recommendation.body: Accept the patch's owned steering, scoped SDK retry default, bounded outer retry, and takeover resend behavior as the canonical agent-runtime policy.
